Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human adenosine A3 receptor in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Adenosine A3 receptor' and assay organism 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier and return all matching rows without deduplication.
